tapToSwap: Tasi le paʻi e fesuiai lau lalolagi pe faʻasaʻo faʻamatalaga
stopToSwitch: Taofi le server e sui lalolagi
ramHighPerf: Fa'atonuga maualuga - e ono mafua ai le vevela tele
ramManualHint: Seti se tu'ufa'atasiga masani o le RAM
releaseTrain26Body: O oe i Minecraft %s . O lo'o matou fa'aleleia pea le 26.x i le PocketCraft — sui i le 1.21.x mo se poto masani.
viewDistanceDesc: O le a le mamao o lo'o utaina ai fasi
viewDistanceHint: Tau maualalo e fautuaina mo masini maualalo
simulationDistanceDesc: Tiki le mamao mo tagata leaga / fua
maxPowerModeDesc: Fa'aaogā le RAM atoa ma le mamao fa'asili. E ono mafua ai le vevela tele.
mobSpawningDesc: Faʻaitiitia le aofaʻi o faʻalapotopotoga mo le faʻatinoina lelei
autoRestartDesc: Toe amata otometi le server pe a pa'u
forceExternalJvmDesc: Fa'aaoga se JVM fafo nai lo le fa'apipi'i
openFolderDesc: Su'e faila faila i lau pule faila
chooseLanguage: Filifili lau gagana e te mana'o ai
managePluginsDesc: Pulea masini fa'apipi'i ma pusa punaoa
noResourcePacksInstalled: E le'i fa'apipi'iina ni pusa puna'oa
useAddButton: Fa'aoga le Add button e fa'aulufale mai ai se faila, pe fa'apipi'i se tasi mai le mata'iloa.
deleteConfirmDesc: O lenei mea e aveese ai le faila mai le faʻasologa o loʻo iai nei.
pluginsTip: Tu'u i luga Bukkit/Spigot/Pepa fa'apipi'i .jar. Su'e plugini ile spigotmc.org po'o hangar.papermc.io
tapToAddPlugin: Tap 'Add Plugin' e lafo ai se faila .jar
noInternetConnection: Leai se initaneti. Fa'amolemole siaki lau feso'otaiga.
hubModLoaderDesc: E le'o fa'aogaina e lenei 'au'aunaga se fa'apipi'i fa'aoga lagolago. Su'e lenei 'au'auna ile Fabric po'o le Quilt e fa'apipi'i mods.
hubSectionDownloadedDesc: Pulea mea ua uma ona teuina mo lenei fa'aumau.
hubSectionDiscoverDesc: Na'o fa'ai'uga i luga ole laiga o lo'o fa'aalia iinei. Ua fa'ailoga afitusi fa'apipi'i mo oe.
hubNoDownloaded: E le'i la'uina %s mo lenei fa'amatalaga.
hubNoOnlineResults: Leai %s i luga ole laiga e fetaui ma lenei sailiga.
hubLoadingOnline: Tu'u i luga ole laiga i'uga...
hubDeleteDesc: O lenei mea o le a aveesea tumau ai le faila mai le version server.
hubSearchRetry: O su'esu'ega o lo'o fa'apolopolo ma fa'atapula'a fua, o le toe taumafai i se taimi e masani lava ona aoga.
hubDetailApplyDesc: Toe amata le server pe a uma ona sui plugins poʻo pusa.
worldsStopBeforeReset: Taofi le 'au'aunaga a'o le'i toe setiina le lalolagi.
worldsSlotHint: Fa'ase'e agavale e tape. Fa'ato'a mafai ona tapeina lalolagi gaioi pe a taofi le server.
worldsImportGuideDesc: Tap e va'ai pe fa'afefea ona fa'aulufale mai le lalolagi ma le fua.
worldsStopToSwitch: Taofi le server e sui lalolagi
worldsResetDesc: Filifili mea e tape. O mea fa'apipi'i, mods, faila faila, ma server.properties o le a fa'asaoina.
worldsResetRowWorld: Faailoga o le lalolagi (lalolagi, lalolagi_nether, lalolagi_le_muaga)
worldsResetRowPlayers: Fa'amaumauga a le au ta'alo (playerdata, stats, advancements)
worldsResetPreserved: Fa'asaoina i taimi uma: plugins/, mods/, config/, server.properties, ma config files.
worldsRestoreDesc:
O le a toe fa'afo'isia: 
 - Fa'amaumauga o le lalolagi ma le tele 
 - Fa'apipi'i, mods, ma pusa puna'oa 
 - Fa'atonu ma fa'atulagaina o le server 
 
 O le a suia lau faila o lo'o iai nei. 
 Ia mautinoa ua taofi le server ae le'i toe fa'afo'i.
worldsDeleteBackupDesc: E te mautinoa e te mana'o e tape %s ?
worldsDeleteWorldActive: Aveese %s ? O le a sui muamua le PocketCraft i se isi lalolagi sefe.
worldsDeleteWorldInactive: Aveese %s ? O lenei mea e aveese ai le lalolagi mai le teuina.
worldsImportGuideText1: Aternos fa'atau atu e mafai ona fa'apipi'iina e 3 ZIP eseese: Overworld, Nether, and The End.
worldsImportGuideText2: O le tele o isi fa'amaumauga o le lalolagi ua uma ona aofia uma itu i totonu o le archive e tasi, o lea ua lava ai le fa'aulufaleina mai o le lalolagi e tasi.
filesAddAnotherWorld: Fa'aopoopo se isi lalolagi ae le'i tapeina lenei.
filesSeedUsedFor: O fatu e fa'aaogaina mo tupulaga
filesSeedCopied: Ua kopiina fatu ile laupapa kilipa.
filesSeedDialogDesc: Ulufale se fatu mo lou lalolagi. Tu'u ai gaogao mo se lalolagi fa'afuase'i.
filesDeleteWorldDesc: O le a tapeina tumau %s ma sui i se isi lalolagi laveai pe a iai se tasi.
onboardingWelcomeTitle:
O lau telefoni ua 
 o se server Minecraft
onboardingWelcomeSubtitle:
Faʻafeiloaʻi sapalai Java Edition mo le leai o se totogi. 
 Leai se PC e mana'omia. Taaalo ma soo se tasi.
onboardingAgreeTermsPolicy: Ou te ioe i aiaiga & aiaiga
onboardingStep1Body: Pepa e tamo'e fa'apitonu'u i luga o lau telefoni ma fa'aoga le manatua ua uma ona e maua.
onboardingStep2Body: PocketCraft e tu'uina atu ia te oe se tuatusi fa'asalalau tulaga ese e mafai ona feso'ota'i i ai uo.
onboardingStep3Body: O tagata ta'alo Java Edition e feso'ota'i sa'o i le fa'ailoga ma sina fe'ese'esea'iga.
onboardingImportSubtitle: Aumai lou lalolagi, plugins, ma config faatasi ma oe. Leai se toe amata.
onboardingImportWorldTitle: Tu'u i luga le zip lalolagi
onboardingImportWorldBody: Lafoa'i mai Aternos, tu'u le fa'amaumauga ile PocketCraft, ma fa'aauau.
onboardingImportPluginsBody: Toe fa'aaoga faila tutusa .jar. O lau fa'aputuga fa'apipi'i fa'atasi ma oe.
onboardingImportConfigBody: server.properties, whitelist, ma le fa'aoga avanoa e tumau pea.
onboardingFeaturesTitle: Pule atoa, i totonu o lau taga
onboardingFeaturesSubtitle: E le o se app ua aveese. O le mea moni a le server toolkit.
onboardingFeaturesBanner: Mea uma e te manaʻomia i le nofoaga e tasi
onboardingFeaturesConsoleBody: Faʻatonu poloaiga ma matamata i ogalaau
onboardingCrossPlaySubtitle: PocketCraft e lagolagoina Java ma Bedrock cross-play pe a mafai le alalaupapa i lau seti server.
onboardingCrossPlayJavaBedrockBody: O uo i luga o le PC ma le telefoni feaveaʻi e mafai ona faʻatasi i le lalolagi e tasi e ala i le taʻavale.
onboardingCrossPlayNoExtraApp: Leai se isi app mo tagata taaalo
onboardingCrossPlayNoExtraAppBody: Fa'asoa lau tuatusi tuatusi ma e mafai e tagata ta'alo ona feso'ota'i mai a latou lava lomiga i le taimi lava lena.
onboardingCrossPlayExperimental:
⚠️ Vaega Fa'ata'ita'i - Ta'alo i Lau Lava Pule'aga 
 
 O lo'o fa'agasolo pea le fa'agasologa o le kolosi. E ono tupu fa'aletonu ma fa'aletonu ona e le'i lagolagoina aloa'ia lenei vaega. Fa'aaoga i lou lava tulaga lamatia.
onboardingRegionSubtitle: Filifili le server relay e sili ona latalata i au taaalo. E mafai foi ona e suia lenei mea mai le dashboard.
onboardingRegionRecommended: Fautuaina: %s . E mafai lava ona e suia i lalo.
onboardingPermissionsSubtitle: E fa'aoga lea mo le tulaga o le server, numera o tagata ta'alo, ma fa'afouga taua i tua a'o tamo'e lau server.
onboardingPermissionsCardBody: Fa'aalia le tulaga o le 'au'aunaga ma le faitau aofa'i o tagata ta'alo a'o fa'agasolo le server.
onboardingPermissionsStatusSet: Ua uma ona e sauni. Tap Next e fa'aauau ai.
onboardingPermissionsStatusWarn: E mana'omia le avanoa fa'asilasilaga ile la'asaga lea. Tap le faamau i luga, ona faataga lea i le Android.
onboardingPermissionsStatusTap: Tap le faamau i luga, ona talia lea o le faatagaga Android e tatala ai le Next.
onboardingPermissionsError: Fa'ataga le fa'atagaga fa'ailoa e fa'aauau.
onboardingGoogleSubtitle: Saini i totonu nei e mafai ai ona fa'asaoina Google Drive tumaoti. E mafai ona e fa'ase'e lea ma fa'auma muamua le seti.
onboardingGoogleStatusDesc: E teu i totonu o lau faila Google Drive app. PocketCraft e le mafai ona va'ai pe fa'aoga isi au faila Drive.
onboardingGoogleConnectedDesc: O lau server lalolagi, plugins, ma faatulagaga o le a otometi lava ona faaleoleo i: %s
onboardingGoogleSkipNotice: E mafai ona e oomi le Next e aunoa ma le saini i totonu.
onboardingSetupBackupNotice: E mafai ona e toe faʻafoʻisia faʻamaumauga o le lalolagi mulimuli ane i Faʻamau i soʻo se taimi e te sauni ai.
onboardingSetupErrorServerName: Manaomia le igoa o le server.
